candidates.summary: Practical, detail-focused Draftsperson to produce steel detailing and installation drawings for warehouse solutions.
candidates.opening:
About the role
This is a part-time position, 3–4 days per week. Mondays are required, and the remaining days are flexible. You will turn warehouse concepts into accurate drawings for fabrication and installation, producing steel detailing, shop drawings and installation drawings for mezzanine floors, staircases, platforms, handrails and racking systems.
Key responsibilities
- Produce steel detailing, shop drawings and installation drawings for mezzanine floors, staircases, platforms, handrails and racking systems
- Convert sales layouts into clear, buildable designs
- Consider warehouse layouts, material flows and throughput in your designs
- Support R&D and ongoing improvements to warehouse solutions
- Work with sales engineers, installers and external structural engineers to develop and certify designs
- Make sure designs meet the relevant Australian Standards and building codes, such

- Experience in steel detailing and fabrication documentation
- Working knowledge of Australian Standards, building codes, and building permit and approval requirements
- A close-knit, supportive team where your input matters

candidates.title: Graduate Estimator
candidates.summary: Kick-start your engineering career and help deliver essential water infrastructure projects that support communities across Australia.
candidates.opening:
About Guidera O’Connor (GO)
At Guidera O’Connor, we deliver more than infrastructure. We create the essential systems that enable communities and industries to access safe water, protect the environment, and build resilience for the future.
For more than two decades, we have partnered with customers across Australia to solve complex water and wastewater challenges through innovative thinking, specialist expertise, and collaborative project delivery.
Our exclusive focus on the water sector means we understand the unique operational, regulatory, and sustainability challenges our customers face.
By combining engineering excellence, practical construction experience, and a commitment to long-term partnerships, we deliver solutions that maximise value, reduce risk, and leave a positive legacy for the communities we serve.

key_lines: At Guidera O’Connor, we deliver more than infrastructure. We create the essential systems that enable communities and industries to access safe water, protect the environment, and build resilience for the future.

By combining engineering excellence, practical construction experience, and a commitment to long-term partnerships, we deliver solutions that maximise value, reduce risk, and leave a positive legacy for the communities we serve.
With a strong pipeline of projects and continued growth across Australia, Guidera O'Connor is seeking a Graduate Estimator to join our Core Bid Team based in Thebarton.

This is an exciting opportunity for a recent Mechanical or Chemical Engineering graduate or a Construction Management graduate to gain hands-on experience in estimating and bid development within a highly specialised industry. Working closely with experienced Estimators and the Lead Estimator, you will contribute to the preparation of competitive project bids while developing valuable technical, commercial, and stakeholder management skills.
You will work alongside and be supported by a team of experienced professionals, united by Guidera O'Connor's five guiding principles: Care, Integrity, Passion, Respect, and Future.
You are a motivated engineering graduate who enjoys problem-solving, working with numbers, and collaborating with others to achieve successful outcomes.
- A degree in Mechanical or Chemical Engineering, or Construction Management
- Exposure to construction, infrastructure, or the water industry (desirable but not essential)
